"""Push the recreated-UI demo's scene code to the baz project (free path --
`baz scenes create --file`, no AI tokens per the 'trend-to-skill factory'
pattern in the installed baz skill: author TSX locally, baz is the
persistence/review layer, not the generator).

baz scenes are standalone TSX files (window.Remotion globals, no cross-file
imports), so each screen's shared UI (AppShell, Cursor, tokens,
primitives, WizardSteps) is inlined here rather than imported -- matching
what the local Remotion project does via real ES imports.

Known limitation, stated plainly rather than silently worked around: image
sources use staticFile("games/g00.jpg") etc., which resolve against THIS
project's local Remotion public/ folder. baz's own preview/export won't be
able to load those files since they were never uploaded to baz's media
library (79 game-cover + mod-logo files -- not uploaded here to keep this
free/fast). The pushed code is correct and complete for reference/editing;
only image rendering inside baz's own preview will show broken images
until/unless those assets are uploaded to that project too.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

RM = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "remotion" / "src"
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "baz-assets" / "pushed"
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

SHARED_FILES = [
    RM / "ui" / "tokens.ts",
    RM / "ui" / "Cursor.tsx",
    RM / "ui" / "primitives.tsx",
    RM / "ui" / "WizardSteps.tsx",
    RM / "ui" / "AppShell.tsx",
]

# (screen file, component name, duration const, start frame, baz scene name)
SCENES = [
    ("screens/DashboardScreen.tsx", "DashboardScreen", "DURATION_DASHBOARD", 0, "demo_01_dashboard"),
    ("screens/ChooseGameScreen.tsx", "ChooseGameScreen", "DURATION_CHOOSE_GAME", 74, "demo_02_choose_game"),
    ("screens/SizeServerScreen.tsx", "SizeServerScreen", "DURATION_SIZE_SERVER", 142, "demo_03_size_server"),
    ("screens/RegionScreen.tsx", "RegionScreen", "DURATION_REGION", 204, "demo_04_region"),
    ("screens/PaymentScreen.tsx", "PaymentScreen", "DURATION_PAYMENT", 272, "demo_05_payment"),
    ("screens/DeployProgressScreen.tsx", "DeployProgressScreen", "DURATION_DEPLOY_PROGRESS", 350, "demo_06_deploy"),
    ("screens/LiveDashboardScreen.tsx", "LiveDashboardScreen", "DURATION_LIVE_DASHBOARD", 418, "demo_07_live_dashboard"),
    ("screens/ModsScreen.tsx", "ModsScreen", "DURATION_MODS", 480, "demo_08_mods"),
    ("screens/ConfigScreen.tsx", "ConfigScreen", "DURATION_CONFIG", 542, "demo_09_config"),
    ("scenes/SupportCard.tsx", "SupportCard", "DURATION_SUPPORT", 588, "demo_10_support"),
    ("scenes/OutroCta.tsx", "OutroCta", "DURATION_OUTRO", 676, "demo_11_outro"),
]

IMPORT_RE = re.compile(r'^\s*import\s+.*?;?\s*$', re.MULTILINE)
EXPORT_CONST_RE = re.compile(r'^export const ')
EXPORT_FUNC_RE = re.compile(r'^export default function')


def strip_imports(src: str) -> str:
    return IMPORT_RE.sub("", src)


def build_shared_prelude() -> str:
    parts = []
    for f in SHARED_FILES:
        src = f.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        src = strip_imports(src)
        src = EXPORT_CONST_RE.sub("const ", src)
        src = re.sub(r'^export function ', 'function ', src, flags=re.MULTILINE)
        parts.append(f"// --- inlined from ui/{f.name} ---\n{src.strip()}")
    return "\n\n".join(parts)


def build_scene(rel_path: str, comp_name: str, dur_const: str) -> str:
    src = (RM / rel_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    src = strip_imports(src)
    src = EXPORT_FUNC_RE.sub("function", src)
    src = re.sub(rf'^export const {dur_const}', f'const {dur_const}', src, flags=re.MULTILINE)
    return src.strip()


HEADER = """const {
  AbsoluteFill, Sequence, Img, interpolate, Easing, staticFile, useCurrentFrame, useVideoConfig,
} = window.Remotion;

// NOTE: image sources below (staticFile("games/..."), staticFile("mods/..."),
// staticFile("nxeon-logo-crop.png")) point at this project's local Remotion
// public/ folder and were NOT re-uploaded to this baz project's media
// library -- they will not resolve inside baz's own preview/export. The
// scene logic/layout/choreography is otherwise complete and matches the
// delivered video exactly.
"""


def main():
    prelude = build_shared_prelude()
    run(["baz", "context", "add",
         "This project mirrors an 11-scene recreated-UI cursor demo built and rendered "
         "locally in a self-hosted Remotion project (nxeon-promo/edit/remotion). Scenes "
         "demo_01..demo_11 are pushed here via scenes create (deterministic, no AI tokens) "
         "for reference/editing, not as the render source -- the delivered video is "
         "rendered locally. Image assets referenced via staticFile() are NOT in this "
         "project's media library (not uploaded, to stay free/fast); they will 404 in "
         "baz's own preview.", "--label", "instructions"])

    for rel_path, comp_name, dur_const, start, scene_name in SCENES:
        scene_src = build_scene(rel_path, comp_name, dur_const)
        full = f"{HEADER}\n{prelude}\n\n// --- scene: {rel_path} ---\n{scene_src}\n"
        out_file = OUT / f"{scene_name}.tsx"
        out_file.write_text(full, encoding="utf-8")

        # duration is a literal number in each screen file; pull it back out
        m = re.search(rf'const {dur_const}\s*=\s*(\d+)', scene_src)
        duration = m.group(1) if m else "90"

        print(f"-- pushing {scene_name} (start={start}, duration={duration}) --")
        run(["baz", "scenes", "create", "--name", scene_name, "--file", str(out_file),
             "--duration", duration, "--track", "1", "--start", str(start)])


def run(cmd):
    r = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent))
    print(r.stdout[-1500:])
    if r.returncode != 0:
        print("STDERR:", r.stderr[-1500:])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    """Writes the 11 standalone baz-ready TSX files and a shell script that
    pushes them. `baz` isn't on PATH for Python's subprocess on this
    machine (only inside the interactive shell), so the actual `baz`
    invocations happen via that generated script, run separately."""
    prelude = build_shared_prelude()
    lines = [
        "#!/bin/sh",
        "set -e",
        'baz context add "This project mirrors an 11-scene recreated-UI cursor demo built '
        "and rendered locally in a self-hosted Remotion project (nxeon-promo/edit/remotion). "
        "Scenes demo_01..demo_11 are pushed here via scenes create (deterministic, no AI "
        "tokens) for reference/editing, not as the render source -- the delivered video is "
        "rendered locally. Image assets referenced via staticFile() are NOT in this "
        "project's media library (not uploaded, to stay free/fast); they will 404 in baz's "
        'own preview." --label instructions',
    ]

    for rel_path, comp_name, dur_const, start, scene_name in SCENES:
        scene_src = build_scene(rel_path, comp_name, dur_const)
        full = f"{HEADER}\n{prelude}\n\n// --- scene: {rel_path} ---\n{scene_src}\n"
        out_file = OUT / f"{scene_name}.tsx"
        out_file.write_text(full, encoding="utf-8")

        m = re.search(rf'const {dur_const}\s*=\s*(\d+)', scene_src)
        duration = m.group(1) if m else "90"

        lines.append(
            f'baz scenes create --name {scene_name} --file "{out_file}" '
            f'--duration {duration} --track 1 --start {start}'
        )
        print(f"wrote {out_file} (start={start}, duration={duration})")

    script = OUT / "push_all.sh"
    script.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"\nwrote {script} -- run this with the Bash tool to actually push.")

Nothing gets cut off mid-animation anymore because there's no external stitching step — I choreograph every transition directly.

**The UI recreation** — Dashboard, game catalogue (real cover art), plan cards, region picker, payment, deploy progress → "server is live", live dashboard, mods library (real logos), and settings — all rebuilt in React/CSS from your actual screenshots (colors sampled directly from pixels, not eyeballed). Three real bugs I found and fixed during build: the logo was rendering as noise (wrong image scaling — fixed by cropping to content bounds), the payment total wasn't updating with the discount (timing threshold bug), and the cursor was clicking the wrong game tile (bad coordinate math, corrected against the actual rendered layout).
